name: supply_demand
description: A price–quantity market diagram: downward-sloping demand, upward-sloping supply, equilibrium where they cross. Choose this scene for ANY request about markets, demand/supply, equilibrium, price ceilings or floors (shortage/surplus), taxes and deadweight loss, consumer/producer surplus, or curve shifts. All geometry is computed for you — you only choose which ingredients to include.

supply.description: The supply curve. Set to null to draw demand only.

equilibrium.description: Equilibrium marker where D and S cross (shown by default when both curves exist).

guides.description: Dashed guide lines to both axes (default true).

q_label.description: Label on the quantity axis, default "Q*".

p_label.description: Label on the price axis, default "P*".

demand_shift.description: A shifted demand curve D→D′ with a shift arrow.

supply_shift.description: A shifted supply curve S→S′ with a shift arrow.

tax.description: A per-unit tax: draws S+tax above S, the new equilibrium, and (by default) the deadweight-loss triangle. Use for any deadweight-loss-from-tax request.

price_ceiling.description: A binding price ceiling below equilibrium; by default also shows the resulting shortage (Qd > Qs).

price_floor.description: A binding price floor above equilibrium; by default also shows the resulting surplus.

regions.description: Shaded surplus regions at the market equilibrium.

element_ids.supply_curve: the supply curve (when supply is not null)
element_ids.guide_lines: dashed guides from the equilibrium to both axes
element_ids.demand_shift_curve / supply_shift_curve: the shifted curve (when a shift is set)
element_ids.demand_shift_arrow / supply_shift_arrow: arrow from the old to the new curve
element_ids.tax_supply_curve: the S+tax curve (when tax is set)
element_ids.tax_guide_lines: dashed guides at the with-tax equilibrium
element_ids.shortage_guides / surplus_guides: dashed guides at Qd and Qs
element_ids.cs_region / ps_region: shaded consumer/producer surplus (when regions is set)

examples.request: Draw a demand and supply diagram.
Show why a price ceiling creates a shortage.
